name: mirage
text: Done, live on the engine now. Bids can rest up to 800% of the wallet (was 400%). Stake stays at 1/16 Kelly, and the bid margin is a bit lower, 2.0% instead of 2.4%, so more lines qualify and every bid is still positive EV. Popular markets go first, and all the safeguards are unchanged: the sharp-book veto, the per-game cap of $8, the picked-off guard and the repeat guard. The $2 per-bid max also still applies, so thousands of bids means many small ones. Novig holds no cash behind resting bids, so the 800% is exposure if everything filled at once. I'll check how many bids actually go up and report back. To undo it: wallet 400%, margin 2.4%.
